evaluator_mode_status: FINAL PRE-HELDOUT DECISION: manual_audit_only selected after the first pre-registered automated evaluator failed its trap gate and its raw trap artifacts were subsequently lost in a Colab reset. The second pre-registered evaluator was not scored. No automated semantic-fidelity labels will be used.

evaluator_validation_gate.max_candidate_evaluators_enforcement: procedural: every candidate's trap run is retained and listed in results/calibration/changes.md

generation_status: CALIBRATION_STARTING_POINT_NOT_FROZEN: Qwen-recommended non-thinking sampling. May change before freeze only on calibration reliability grounds (schema adherence, parse stability, reproducibility), never on A/B/C performance. Identical for A, B and C.

judge_aggregation.independence: repeated correlated samples from one model, not independent raters
judge_aggregation.invalid_policy: if any sample is invalid or cites a span absent from the response, the item is fidelity-unknown; unknown is never a pass and stays in denominators
judge_aggregation.rule: majority of three repeated samples from one evaluator model

model_revision_status: UNRESOLVED: resolve the exact Hugging Face commit SHA in the GPU environment and record it before calibration. No revision is asserted in this package.

thinking_mode.mechanism: chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false sent on every chat-completions request; additionally start the vLLM server with --default-chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking": false}'
thinking_mode.runtime_check: every raw completion records think_block_detected; any occurrence is a protocol violation reported, never stripped
sources: docs/evidence/qwen3_README.md (Qwen3 README: enable_thinking=False passed to apply_chat_template strictly prevents thinking content)
docs/evidence/vllm_reasoning_outputs.md (vLLM: Qwen3 reasoning is on by default; disable with enable_thinking=False in chat_template_kwargs)
